blind.description: A sturdy, stylized wooden cage with a solid wooden plank top and bottom, vertical wooden bars along the sides, and dark iron strapping reinforced with rounded rivets running along the upper and lower perimeter. One side features a barred door mounted on dark iron hinges and secured with a padlock on the side. The wood has a painted warm brown grain, and the iron hardware is a dark matte charcoal.
blind.from_above: A nearly square wooden surface made of several horizontal wooden planks, framed by slightly raised square corner posts and bordered by dark metal trim along the edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3.8 to 4 feet tall) and about 3.5 feet wide and deep.
